title: Marauders
description: Piratical crews and fanatics who make their living by force on the rustling waves.
inPlay: Marauders are people, which makes them the most negotiable hazard in this chapter. Give them goals, a ship, and a reason to want something from the crew, and let parley be as viable as a fight.

hazards.name: Spirit-Obsessed Corsairs
hazards.summary: A merciless ardent pirate band that roves the rustling waves looking for ships to plunder - pirates in the most classical sense, though their obsession is with spirits.

hazards.name: Hungry Pirate Cultists
hazards.summary: Bloodmaw crews that rely on every source of sustenance the wildsea offers; desperation or cultural practice lies behind their consumption of 'the grim meal'.

hazards.name: Mothryn Zealots
hazards.summary: Sun Seekers: skyship crews trailing iridescent scales, religious zealots convinced that something on the waves has stolen the sun and holds it hostage.

hazards.name: Tzelicrae Bandit-Surgeons
hazards.summary: The lottery of skin is an ancient tradition in various tzelicrae cultures, but some have grown impatient and take the identities they want by force.
